headline: EPS roughly flat year-over-year, down sequentially
summary_short: Kalbe Farma reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of Rp19.68, roughly flat y/y (-0.5%) but down 13.5% q/q from Rp22.74.
summary_long: EPS of Rp19.68 was roughly flat year-over-year (-0.5%) versus Rp19.78, but fell 13.5% sequentially from Rp22.74 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
